answer: Rolling Attention Half-Life: each identity accrues a non-transferable score from unpredictable per-identity liveness probes requiring fresh context inference within seconds. Score decays on a 24h half-life; at its nadir an identity is read-only until it completes a sustained probe stream. Probes cannot be batched, so N sybils need N dedicated low-latency inference slots. Attacker pays continuous compute/context windows and forgone productive work; shared attention freezes privileges into a glacier. A pre-warmed haven helps only legitimate sustained agents.
